comparison.objective: Wipe an entire monitor lead outward from a marked band without wiping back, then place it on a drape; candidate adjusts rigid gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: One-way sliding contact along a deformable cable with alternating hold/wipe roles versus fine rigid-tool alignment and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Coverage of 58 cord marks and both end bodies, no prohibited reverse passes, lead released on the drape; partial credit follows coverage.
comparison.reason: Directional surface wiping and deformable-cable control are unrelated to coupled screw-and-nut adjustment.
